strategies.name: Liquidity Grab Reversal Strategy
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab (price breaking support/resistance and fake-out) and enter at the candle that initiated the grab (long entry at the bottom of the candle, short entry at the top of the candle).
strategies.exit_summary: Set stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at a recent high (for longs) or recent low (for shorts).
